title: Official studio.markers.sidecar import and export
aggregateCanonical: sha256 of sorted "digest  path\n" lines of sourceSha256
bounds: This increment admits only the official marker sidecar named studio.markers.sidecar, recorded as a new written authorization in docs/addenda/marker-sidecar-v1.md and ADR docs/adr/m001-marker-sidecar-v1.md. Those two documents are included in sourceSha256 / aggregateSha256. The original 104-spec snapshot is not rewritten. The envelope is format, formatVersion 1.0.0 (import admits the same major 1.y.z), and markers (an array that may be empty). Each entry round-trips the existing Marker object with rational Time JSON, not floating-point seconds, and does not change the core project schema.

Export writes every selected marker (default: all project markers) and refuses a missing selected id rather than dropping it. Import restores every official field or rejects the whole file. Unknown extra fields are listed as MARKER_SIDECAR_UNSUPPORTED warnings and the file is refused; they are never stripped to invent success. A clipLocal host that is missing or no longer covers the marker is ANCHOR_OUT_OF_RANGE, never quietly rewritten as absolute. A missing target sequenceId is PARENT_MISMATCH. Wrong format or unrecognized major version is MARKER_SIDECAR_INVALID. Marker labels are not burned into preview or MP4, and this sidecar is not an MP4 mux option.

A persist path exports absolute and clipLocal markers to a .studio-markers.json file, refuses a CSV-like format, then imports the sidecar over a later SetMarkers rewrite so the official fields come back and the intervening marker does not remain. WebVTT chapters, CSV, and FCPXML stay closed and are not claimed compatible.

Already-delivered marker absolute default / clipLocal follow / ripple interval, caption semantics, and field-aware invert stay unchanged. Official InversePatch kind stays restoreSnapshot. This slice does not change production algebra, insertion order, or IMPLICIT_GAP. I-005 and I-010 stay partial.
